vision: A future where every Guard family is supported by a connected community—and the strength of those families is recognized as essential to readiness and retention.
mission: Support Guard-connected kids and caregivers with experiences, resources, and trusted relationships that build resilience and stability at home.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Work with local partners
strategicInfrastructure.description: We work with organizations across Iowa to bring events closer to families and connect them with resources they can use at home or at school.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Help families find their next step
strategicInfrastructure.description: We share what’s coming up, what to expect, and who to contact with questions. We also help families learn about opportunities beyond our events, including camps and Yellow Ribbon programs.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Pay attention to what helps
strategicInfrastructure.description: We track who we’re reaching and ask kids and parents what they got out of an event or what made it hard to attend. We use what we learn to plan future events and decide where families could use more support.

strategicInfrastructure.title: Speak up for Guard families
strategicInfrastructure.description: We share what families tell us with partners and Guard leaders so they can see what’s helping and where families still need support.

visionDetails: We want every Iowa Guard kid and parent to know they have people in their corner. We hope the kids who grow up with us become teens that younger kids look up to.

By the time they graduate, we hope they’re proud of growing up in a Guard family, see the opportunities it gave them, and find their own way to honor their parent’s service and give back. We want Guard leaders to see strong, connected families as part of what helps service members stay ready and continue serving.

coreValues.title: Belonging
coreValues.description: Every Guard kid and parent deserves a place to feel welcome and understood. We want families to leave our events knowing they have people they can turn to.

coreValues.title: Connection
coreValues.description: At camp, Yellow Ribbon, or another event, kids can meet a friend who understands what it’s like when a parent leaves for training or deployment.

coreValues.title: Leadership
coreValues.description: We ask teens to look out for younger kids and set an example for their peers. Sometimes that means noticing who’s on their own and inviting them in.

coreValues.title: Pride
coreValues.description: Growing up in a Guard family can be hard. We hope kids look back with pride in how much they grew and in the service their family was part of.

coreValues.title: Service
coreValues.description: We hope kids give back in a way that feels right to them, whether they volunteer with CYP, serve in the military, or speak up for Guard families.
